create_loader_and_network: create a RoIDataLoader and Caffe2 DAG network from sample data for training or testing
run_net: run a Caffe2 network once and fetch the data blob from GPU zero
get_roidb_blobs: stack ROI database entries into a numpy blob dictionary for data loading
get_net: build a Caffe2 DAG net with DequeueBlobs ops for each configured GPU
test_two_parallel_loaders: test two parallel RoIDataLoader instances with mocked minibatch functions to verify correct data dequeuing
